name: @ttt-productions/chat-schemas
description: The chat realtime wire and internal-call contracts (subprotocol, frame kinds and payloads, close codes, conversation reference, room address, grant, internal-call audiences and bodies, client-agreed limits) in pure Zod/TS, with message text judged by input-format-core. Tier 1 — consumed by the chat React client, the chat Cloudflare Worker, and Cloud Functions without forcing the chat UI dep graph on backend callers.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

author: DJ (TTT Productions)
